purpose: Column confinement enhancement ratio that gives a structural ductility ratio of 5.5 for the frame of CONFINEMENT_NONCONSTANT_ELASTIC_OR_INELASTIC_FRAME, found by the source's Newton iteration on the pushover (fifth of the seven sub-models of CONFINEMENT_ENHANCEMENT_RATIO).
Description of Building Structural Syste: Single-storey portal frame with fixed bases: two 3 m columns of 500 x 500 mm (six 25 mm bars, 50 mm cover) and a 7 m beam of 500 x 300 mm (eight 18 mm bars); the column confinement ratio is the search variable (optimum 2.147), the other sections take X - 0.15, X - 0.1 and X - 0.2.
Description of Model: OPTIMIZATION_CONFINEMENT_ENHANCEMENT_RATIO
Material: RC (Concrete01 confined core and cover, f'c 25 MPa; Hysteretic reinforcement as written)
Lateral system: Portal frame with confinement ratios varying along the frame
Lateral Loading: Pushover (horizontal displacement control of node 4), repeated in each step of the search; no time history
Links to Papers / Design Reports: https://github.com/salardelavar/OPENSEES_SALAR/tree/main/CONCRETE_FRAME_EXAMPLES/CONFINEMENT_ENHANCEMENT_RATIO/OPTIMIZATION_CONFINEMENT_ENHANCEMENT_RATIO (source repository; the source's PDF and PowerPoint were not parsed)
Notes: Source py_ref/CONCRETE_FRAME_OPTIMIZATION_CONFINEMENT_ENHANCEMENT_RATIO.py converted to the AGENT.md layout. The Newton search on the column ratio (start 1.40, target ductility 5.5) converges in five iterations to X* = 2.147387; the optimum's over-strength factor is 1.1256 and its ductility 5.5 (LESSON 86). The source's transient branch is never called and is not converted (LESSON 84). The column fibre mesh has one fibre across the width, which does not change the in-plane response (LESSON 87). The search runs its pushovers in separate processes (LESSON 85) and saves each iteration (LESSON 88).

Lateral system: Portal frame with confinement ratios varying along the frame
